description: An explicit @ over a unary plus or minus over a multi-cell range, alone and inside T and N: is the @ applied to the range (an implicit intersection, #VALUE! off the range's rows) or to the value the sign makes (review of CR-321672244, round 1, reviewer 1 N4; a sibling of t-n-at-unary-plus-if-array). The formulas in column A are off the rows of the ranges, each with four empty rows below it; row 202 holds four of them (the three plus forms over H and I, and the bare @) on a row of the ranges. Columns D and P hold FORMULATEXT, to see whether Excel keeps the plus.
